subject: Production cutover rehearsal & coordination — final sync for go-live owners
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@acmehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-09-10T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Final go-live rehearsal: proposed dates & attendees

Hi Marcus / Monica,

Thanks again for the roadmap review last week. Were targeting the production cutover for the weekend of Sep 18, and procurement asked that we run one final synchronized rehearsal with all owners before the weekend. Goal is to validate the runbook, confirm fallback owners, and exercise the rollback path end-to-end.

Attendees we plan to include from Acme: Elaine Park (apps lead), Sarah Kim (procurement), and two platform engineers (TBD). From Redwood wed like AE + SE + on-call infra/security.

Can you confirm availability for a 60-minute rehearsal on any of these windows (PT):
- Wed Sep 15 — 16:00-17:00 PT
- Thu Sep 16 — 10:00-11:00 PT
- Fri Sep 17 — 09:00-10:00 PT

Were attaching the current cutover checklist (acme_cutover_checklist_v3.pdf) for your review. If you have a preferred owner list for rollback/fallback, please call that out.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Director of Engineering, Acme Health
(attachment: acme_cutover_checklist_v3.pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@acmehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-11T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final go-live rehearsal: proposed dates & attendees

Elaine  thanks for the checklist and the windows. Well prioritize Wed Sep 15 16:00-17:00 PT if that works for your team. Monica (SE) will lead the technical run-through; Ill coordinate the agenda and make sure we have a clear cutover owner + fallback owners documented.

Request: could we also have Rishi (security/on-call) and Aditya (infra) on the invite so they can confirm access and rollback steps? Ill draft a 60-minute agenda focused on the critical path: DB migrations, traffic switch, KV cache invalidation, and monitoring/playback.

Ill send a calendar invite once times are confirmed and attach the runbook stub.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Thanks Elaine — Wed Sep 15 16:00-17:00 PT works for me.

Draft agenda (60 min):
- 0-10 min: Introductions & scope of rehearsal (Marcus)
- 10-25 min: Infra readiness & checks (Aditya)
- 25-40 min: DB/Stateful migrations and verification (Monica)
- 40-50 min: Security/roles & audit checks (Rishi)
- 50-60 min: Fallback/rollback steps + owners confirmation (all)

Proposed fallback owner assignments (so were explicit):
- DB rollback / snapshot restore: Rishi Malhotra (on-call)
- Network / routing rollback: Aditya Rao
- Monitoring & verification / go-no-go: Grace O'Connor

Ive attached a working rehearsal agenda (final_rehearsal_agenda.md) that Ill update before the call. Please flag any missing items or extra apps that need a run-through.

Monica Patel

Im on for Wed Sep 15 16:00-17:00 PT. Quick notes from a security/on-call standpoint:
- Confirm service account roles and any temporary elevated creds before the rehearsal. If we need emergency keys, we should use the short-lived token flow we tested last quarter.
- I will own DB rollback verification (snapshot restore + smoke tests) as Monica suggested. If Im on-call during the cutover I will be primary rollback owner; Grace O'Connor will be fallback owner for verification/monitoring.
- Please confirm that procurement (Sarah) has the DocuSign/SLA/PO timeline so we can verify billing/credits if something goes wrong. Sarah, can you confirm PO status?

Procurement/PO note: Ive seen this stall before; if the POs not in by Friday we should still run the rehearsal but mark the release as contingent on PO finalization.
